---
title: "BUSOWN: Business Ownership"
description: "Concordances to enable MADIP data about sole traders and partnership beneficiaries to be linked to BLADE data about the businesses they operate."
---

Concordances to enable MADIP data about sole traders and partnership beneficiaries to be linked to BLADE data about the businesses they operate.

*Provides the official PLIDA data item list and explains person-to-business links with BLADE.*
